title: fix: preserve code spans adjacent to tildes
body:
**Marked version:** master / 18.0.5

**Markdown flavor:** GitHub Flavored Markdown

## Description

- Fixes #4011
- Keep adjacent tilde and backtick delimiter runs separate so complete code spans remain available to the code-span tokenizer.
- Keep delimiter handling in the selected GFM text grammar and stop immediately at mixed delimiter boundaries.
- Cover both delimiter orders, multi-backtick code spans, and code nested in strikethrough.

## Contributor

- [x] Test(s) exist to ensure functionality and minimize regression.
- [x] No documentation change is required because this restores existing GFM parsing behavior.

## Committer

In most cases, this should be a different person than the contributor.

- [ ] CI is green (no forced merge required).
- [ ] Squash and Merge PR following conventional commit guidelines.

linked_issues.title: Inline code after a tilde is parsed with shifted backticks
linked_issues.body:
**Marked version:** 18.0.5 **Markdown flavor:** GitHub Flavored Markdown **Describe the bug** A literal tilde immediately followed by an inline code span causes the opening backtick to be consumed as text. Subsequent backticks are then paired incorrectly. **To Reproduce** 1. Create an empty directory and install Marked: ```sh npm init -y npm install marked@18.0.5 ``` 2. Save this as `repro.mjs`: ```js import assert from "node:assert/strict" import { marked } from "marked" const markdown = "~`0.1576` to measurement-window-only `0.00092`" const expected = "

~0.1576 to measurement-window-only 0.00092

\n" const actual = marked.parse(markdown) console.log(actual) assert.equal(actual, expected) ``` 3. Run `node repro.mjs`. Actual output: ```html

~`0.1576to measurement-window-only0.00092`

``` **Expected behavior** The tilde should remain literal and both complete backtick pairs should be parsed as code spans: ```html

~0.1576 to measurement-window-only 0.00092

```
